about: Front ES1 review 2: words on the glossary's forbidden lists that are correct in a given string, each with a reason. Several usted imperatives (use, guarde, cargue, abra, espere, revise, escriba) are also third-person subjunctives, and «vale» also appears in «vale la pena». Keys are the lint's string ids (`catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<text>`); `words` are the forbidden words allowed in that string only. Front SC9 (the lints on src/i18n/lint/): an entry may also name `placeholders` the translation adds; `words` exempt only the glossary's forbidden words (es.test.ts checks it).

map:languageChoice.originalsNote.reason: third-person subjunctive in «la próxima vez que se cargue la página», not an usted imperative

catalog:pulsarLab.problem.beam.reason: VIREO's own message “No Pulsar in Beam!”, quoted exactly in English

catalog:pulsarLab.sourceHelp.reason: names kept as written: the file Pulsars.dat and the ATNF Pulsar Catalogue

catalog:pulsarLab.step.point.help.reason: VIREO's captions Pulsar Parameters and Find Pulsar, given in English after the Spanish names

map:clusterData.useTelescopeOff.reason: the quoted VIREO caption “Use Telescope Coordinates” in English, not a Spanish imperative

original:fragment|Meter Radio Telescope.reason: VIREO composes the dish diameter in front of this fragment («40 Meter Radio Telescope»); the Spanish caption puts it inside («Radiotelescopio de {diameter} metros»)
